scope: Independent read-only privacy UI/model contract review; no browser, PostgreSQL or live acceptance

findings.summary: Untrimmed reviewed reason is incompatible with the real governance schema normalization.
findings.evidence: Actual privacy.request schema/handler trims surrounding whitespace and succeeds; privacyCreatedRequest rejects its returned reason against the untrimmed immutable UI input. The existing same-key retry repeats the mismatch.
findings.requiredCorrection: Trim once before creating/validating the immutable reviewed input, validate normalized length, and preserve that exact normalized input/key for retries. This does not change the existing backend parsed-input digest.
findings.regression: Leading/trailing whitespace succeeds with actual trimmed response; whitespace-only reason fails before posting.

findings.summary: Present inconsistent companyId is not rejected on selected requests, created ACKs, status or compact prepared ACKs.
findings.evidence: Seven actual model probes accept foreign/null company fields for the same subject. Saved artifact data/snapshot company checks already exist, but the selected request is not checked. This is a contract-integrity gap, not a demonstrated bypass of the server tenant ACL.
findings.requiredCorrection: Validate every present companyId in applicable request/request.data and result/status/ACK records against actor.companyId. Keep absence compatible with legacy Entity and v1. Reviewer views can validate current company without requiring the reviewer to be the subject.
findings.regression: Present foreign/null company rejects at each affected entry point; legacy absent fields still pass.

acceptedScopedObservations: Absent-only legacy v1 and explicit v2 checks preserve the intended request/ACK/version distinctions.

Compact prepared ACK is validated without inventing a snapshot endpoint; saved cards validate outer/snapshot/request version, own subject, immutable marker, checksum shape, categories and v2 company metadata.
Fresh catalog checks precede request/export POST, preserve a selected unsupported v2 and prevent automatic downgrade.
Reviewed input/key is stable across same-intent unknown ACK retries; edited input gets a new key. Export keys are retained per request within the adopted session.

Console is keyed by complete actor and CSRF token; private generation invalidates late callbacks and queued updates on unmount/revocation. Terminal access errors invoke the parent private-state reset.
Status overlays presentation fields only; it cannot replace the selected request reason/categories/version/owner.
Reviewer displays read-only scope and forwards requestId/expectedVersion without a version override.
All six locale columns follow DE/UK/RU/PL/LT/EN and describe stored records, omissions and incomplete legal fulfillment.
Only one resolver export and one App callback change affect existing shared components; no unrelated runtime changes observed.

presentationNote.detail: Scope currently reuses a flex privacy-boundary class for several paragraphs; root plans a separate wrapping/block scope class and rendered mobile check. No browser result is claimed.

independentContractProbes.scope: Actual UI model and actual governance schema/handler; memory transaction only

firstProbeRunnerAttempt.cause: tsx CLI attempted an unnecessary IPC listener and received EPERM; preserved. Direct Node import used no IPC listener.

nextGate: Root corrective model/UI delta and focused regressions, then independent delta review. Rendered suite/CI inventory is a separate scope.
